reason: The inference misuses def-extended-delta-inclusion: an extended delta-inclusion requires every amplification to be a delta-homomorphism, and the allowed source definition of a delta-homomorphism in the *-algebra setting requires exact involution preservation v(X^dagger)=v(X)^dagger. The conditional input node 1.2 provides only ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger|| <= K_hom*e*||X||. Taking C_merge >= K_hom does not turn this approximate bound into exact equality when e>0. Thus even if 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.2, and 1.3 were validated, their stated conclusions would not make gamma_n a C_merge*e-homomorphism, so the claimed extended C_merge*e-isomorphism does not follow.
